purpose.zh: 低负荷练脚踝内翻的主动控制
purpose.en: Train low-load control of turning the sole inward.

text.zh: 小腿不动，脚底慢慢向内翻
text.en: Keep your shin still and slowly turn the sole of your foot inward

text.zh: 单手轻扶椅子，一只脚悬空
text.en: Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift one foot off the floor.

text.zh: 小幅度翻到位，再慢慢回正
text.en: Turn through a small range, then come back slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 用转小腿或转髋代替脚踝
commonErrors.en: Turning the shin or hip instead of the ankle.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
